findings: acp-agent.ts:2080 claudeCliPath() prefers CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE, then the SDK platform package matching the runtime libc.
acp-agent.ts:11487 sets settingSources [user, project, local] before spreading the client's _meta.claudeCode.options, so the client can replace it.

acp-agent.ts:11551-11583 merges the client's hooks with the adapter's own PreToolUse callbacks (subagent configuration on the RFD form, Edit|Write preview on v2). Callbacks cannot cross JSON-RPC, so ORCA's hook must arrive as a command hook in settings.

effects.ts:68-77 and 161-175: for Bash and mcp__ tools, 'allow with updates' applies the native CLI's own permission_suggestions, so the breadth and destination of the remembered rule are decided natively.
The merged claude-decode excerpt (response.ts lines 6-36) still matches this revision byte for byte (sha256 97856957...bfc10e).

relied: PreToolUse permissionDecision allow skips the permission prompt; deny and ask rules are still evaluated.
Exit code 0 with no output means no decision: the call continues through the normal permission flow.
PreToolUse hooks run before every tool call; PermissionRequest hooks run only when Claude Code is about to ask, or would auto-deny a call that cannot prompt.
onFailure block (v2.1.295+) turns a hook that cannot start, times out, exits other than 0 or 2, or prints invalid output into a block; unset, those failures continue.
Multiple PreToolUse decisions resolve deny > defer > ask > allow; defer ends the turn and needs -p.
Hooks from settings, managed policy and plugins also run inside subagents; MCP tools appear as mcp__<server>__<tool>.
Direct edits to hooks in settings files are normally picked up by the file watcher.
Evaluation order: hooks, deny rules, ask rules, permission mode, allow rules, canUseTool.
Auto-approved tools never reach canUseTool; an allow rule skips the callback.
For checks that must run on every tool call, use a PreToolUse hook.
Read for SDK callback-hook context only; the experiment uses a settings command hook.
2.1.309 to 2.1.311 hook and sandbox entries summarized under newerAvailable.
settingSources [] disables filesystem settings (SDK isolation mode).
settings is the flag tier and carries hooks.
managedSettings from a parent is filtered restrictive-only and dropped when an admin managed tier exists; whether hooks survive that filter is not stated.
